contexts.text: To praise and celebrate the Lord is not an active life; but the effect of that life; for the Lord has no need of praises; but wills us to perform the goods of charity... HH 404. SE 3986.
These are the praises of Jehovah (); that is, internal worship.
They praised her to Pharaoh () = that they were pleasing.
Goods and truths, which are the praises of Jehovah. 3242[2].
Attends only to the delight... from the praise... of self.
Enter... His courts in praise ()... Praise is from the love of truth.
From the mouth of infants... Thou hast perfected praise () = that praise can come to the Lord through noway except through innocence...
To be venerated with praises () = that to Him alone are the glory and thanksgiving. Explained.
To praise with the timbrel () = to glorify from the delight of the affection of the good of faith; and to praise with the harp = from the pleasantness of the affection of the truth of faith.
When others praise, venerate, and worship them, their faces are contracted, and appear as if glad...
Among those he calls his own are all who praise... him. NJHD 67.
Praise our God () = (an influx that) they should worship! the Lord as the only God of Heaven.
That to praise God = to worship Him; and thence that His praise is His worship. Illustrated.
They whispered a votive praise to the Lord, and (then) reposed themselves at the table.
While writing he continually reflects on self-praise.
He could praise no one from his heart.
To announce the praises of Jehovah = evangelization concerning the Lord, and the worship of Him.
Worship from these things is signified by to praise Jehovah... ().
To praise the gods of gold... = worship from the love of self...
To praise Jehovah () = to worship Him. AE 401:23. AE 419:15.
Praise is predicated of the truth of the doctrine of the Church.
To praise = to worship. AE 587:17. AE 630:13.
Their joy from the preaching and Knowledge of truth, is meant by to sing praise and lift up the voice ().
Praise God all His servants () = the worship of the Lord by those in truths. To praise God = to confess and worship Him. Illustrated.
